notes.title: New Console Available - PlayStation 5 🔵
notes.content:
[h2][b]Attention Cops! 🚨 [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]We have a report that Police Shootout is now available on PlayStation 5, please send all patrols to check it out 🚔 👇[/b][/h3]

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011966


[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011966][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37408145/39a0ceccfe0fb2e26b6fd4ed9f41c3149e73b3d0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]We are very pleased to announce that [b]Police Shootout[/b] is now available on [b]PlayStation 5! 👮[/b]👮‍♂️ Start your adventure in San Andrino today on Microsoft's blue console 🔵 A new challenge is already waiting for you 🚔[/h3]

[h3]Start your policeman’s career, solve cases, gain experience, and begin your adventure in San Adrino today on [b]PlayStation 5[/b]! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=nue6HilJUXM;full][/previewyoutube]

Have fun!
Police Shootout Team

notes.title: Police Shootout Prologue v1.01 update
notes.content:
Hello!

We have the first small update of the prologue.
We are reading all your feedback; more things are coming!

- We fixed shotgun shooting animation issue happening when player start shoot just after taking out the gun
- Fixed situation when player could start conversation with NPCs in some wrong moments
- Fixed level selection issue on the map

Police Shootout Team :)

notes.title: Prologue - Released - PLAY FOR FREE
notes.content:
[h1][b]HELLO OFFICERS![/b] 👮‍♀️👮‍♂️[/h1]

[h2]🚨[b]Police Shootout: Prologue is NOW on Steam! [/b]🚨[/h2]
[h2]You can download it totally for free! Just click the link below 👇[/h2] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661280/Police_Shootout_Prologue/
🚔 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1661280/discussions/0/3276941086776034010/]PROLOGUE | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]

👮‍♀️ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1661280/discussions/0/3276941086776035944/]PROLOGUE | BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url]

[h2][b]PLAY NOW[/b] 🔥[/h2]

[b]Some of you are surely wondering what a prologue is?[/b] 
So Police Shootout: Prologue is a part of the full version of the game and is completely free. You will get to know many new interesting features, especialy voice overs for 13 languages. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of Police Shootout so you will be fully ready before the final product release! We count on your feedback and suggestions for the game. 😊

[h3][b]Join our community on Discord![/b][/h3]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

The full version is coming really soon, so stay tuned. 😊
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279240/Police_Shootout/

Regards, 
Police Shootout Team
